result:
**Verdict: FAIL** on DG2 candidate `sha256:8ef26b71…` (commit `98a8d99`), round 1. I recomputed the candidate ID and it matches. HEAD moved during the run, but only because other reviewers' run evidence was committed, which the candidate excludes. I authored no product code.

Most of the candidate is solid; the gate fails because of two High mandatory findings plus one Medium mandatory one.

**What passed** (all executed, evidence in `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG2/qa/`):
- **Build and static checks:** typecheck, build, lint, OpenAPI lint (160 operations), no-CDN, format and contrast all passed.
- **Unit tests:** 465/465 on both Node 22.22.2 and Node 24.21.0.
- **Integration:** 414/414 in each of two runs on separate throwaway PostgreSQL 16 databases. Migrations 0001–0018 apply, the database guards fire, the contract test exercises all 160 operations, and both pending lists are empty.
- **End-to-end:** 42/42 in English and Arabic, with no accessibility (axe) violations of any severity on 46 pages per language.
- **Pipeline and reconcile validator checks** passed.
- **My own acceptance tests**, saved under `test-evidence/DG2/qa/tests/` so the candidate is untouched: 16 of 17 pass consistently across two runs. They cover:
  - T01–T04 register rules: the Confidence check, a missing target date, a missing dimension, D-01 numbering and Open default.
  - Charter: the 14 fields, version history, date validation and the 3–5 top-outcome warning.
  - The "Launch new app" good outcome test.
  - North Star: only one current at a time, even under concurrent writes.
  - Baselines and value pools: Unknown and unquantified are never 0, and Finance validation goes stale after an edit.
  - Gates: rejected without a charter, filename-only evidence stays incomplete, 403 for non-approvers and submitters, 409 for a superseded submission, and approval advances the phase.
  - Access: the full role list, accountability text matching B0018 word for word, cross-transformation isolation and read-only auditors.
  - Modes, the TOM screens and the entity group.

**Findings** (proposed IDs in QA's 2xx range):

| ID | Severity | Mandatory | Finding |
|---|---|---|---|
| F-DG2-201 | High | yes | G2 can never be completed through the product. KPI definitions are always created as `draft` and no operation can make them `active`, but the G2 KPI criterion requires an active one. So G2 can't be submitted, and the Diagnose→Design journey (REQ-PB-017, REQ-S04-004, REQ-DLV-034) can't finish. Same result in 2/2 runs; the existing test suites only ever submit G1, which is why it wasn't caught. |
| F-DG2-202 | High | yes | The frozen requirement register still marks all 32 DG2 requirements as SPECIFIED with no evidence, so `validate.mjs --register DG2` fails with 64 problems. |
| F-DG2-203 | Medium | yes | The charter's transformation thesis (REQ-PB-030) doesn't follow the playbook sentence in B0037 ("If we change…, then… will improve, which will create…, because…"), in English or Arabic. No sentence is assembled from the four parts, and nothing flags the thesis as incomplete; empty parts just show "None". |
| F-DG2-204 | Medium | no | After the North Star is refined, the charter keeps showing the superseded statement with no stale marker. The header and the G2 check use the current one. |
| F-DG2-205 | Medium | no | In an End-to-End transformation, approving G3 while G2 was never approved moves the phase straight from Define to Mobilize. The playbook (B0009) says End-to-End runs phases 1–6 in order. |
| F-DG2-206 | Low | no | QA's own end-to-end stack script (`e2e/support/qa-stack.sh`) doesn't configure evidence storage, so file uploads fail with 503 under it. This is a test-harness gap, not a product defect; the frontend's harness sets it and runs 42/42. It's my file, to fix in the next stage. |

The review record is `docs/delivery/reviews/DG2/round-1/qa-verifier.json`, with the findings in `qa-verifier.findings.json` next to it. Both pass schema validation and every evidence path exists.

The throwaway clone and copied package store are deleted. The integration tests left `mth-evidence-it-*` scratch folders in my run's temporary directory, which the runner deletes when the run ends.
